name: Marcus Molinaro
summary:
Marcus James Molinaro ( moh-lin-AIR-oh; born October 8, 1975) is an American politician from the state of New York who served in Congress and in the second presidential administration of Donald Trump.
A member of the Republican Party, Molinaro was elected to the Village of Tivoli's Board of Trustees at the age of 18. In 1995, he became the youngest mayor in the U.S. when he was elected mayor of Tivoli at age 19.
